{{Top|leg}}
'''Lotrent''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Lotrent used [[detonite tape]] to blow open vehicle hatches and capture [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
